listing.title: Authentic Jodhpur Hand-Embroidered Cotton Square Tapestry
listing.description: Handcrafted in the historic city of Jodhpur, Rajasthan, this exquisite textile features intricate traditional hand embroidery on premium cotton cloth. Meticulously detailed over five days of dedicated craftsmanship, this piece showcases the vibrant heritage and timeless needlework techniques passed down through generations of Rajasthani artisans.
